recipe.label: FIGARO E3 2015 ixi
recipe.attribution: Credit the European Commission JRC and the dataset authors; indicate changes. FIGARO E3 retains its own source terms.
recipe.ghg_note: Source-characterised AR5 GWP100 CO2eq (CO2, CH4, N2O and F-gases). The parser-specific isolated Irish paper-incineration loop correction retains original production accounts; its unallocable emissions stay by production origin, without consumer allocation.
recipe.value_added_footprint_note: The native industry IOT contains negative net operating surplus and a negative-output node; these source signs are retained and its value-added footprint can be negative. The source SUT is a separate available representation.

notes.gross_output: Native MARIO X for IOTs and Xc for SUTs, summed over producing nodes. Gross output includes intermediate production at multiple stages and is not GDP.
notes.domestic_use: Domestic-origin use within the same native region only: matching origin and destination regions in Z and Y (IOT) or U and Yc (SUT). Intermediate and final uses enter once; signed source adjustments are retained.
notes.final_demand: Final demand by consumer region from Y (IOT) or Yc (SUT). Domestic and Imported identify the supplying row region relative to that consumer. A shared SNA category vocabulary is used; native combined categories are never split or duplicated. Households + NPISH combines the observed household and NPISH source columns where separately supplied.
notes.value_added_footprint: Reviewed value added generated by domestic and foreign producers to meet final demand in the selected consumer region. Native direct coefficients retain production origins before MARIO calc_m_from_z solves the system. Multiplication by Y/Yc retains final-consumer columns; no full inverse is constructed.
notes.ghg_footprint: Allocable GHG supported by final demand in the consumer region, plus supplied direct final-user emissions once. MARIO calc_ghg uses the reviewed source characterisation, and calc_f_from_z retains production origins before multiplying by Y/Yc. Direct accounts and upstream requirements outside the representable final-demand boundary stay quantified by production origin. Source-characterised AR5 GWP100 CO2eq (CO2, CH4, N2O and F-gases). The parser-specific isolated Irish paper-incineration loop correction retains original production accounts; its unallocable emissions stay by production origin, without consumer allocation.
notes.value_added_trade: Upstream value added embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Domestic and Foreign identify value added generated inside or outside the exporting native region. Total includes both and can closely match gross monetary trade in balanced systems. Repeated border crossings can count the same value added again; this is not value-added exports measured by ultimate foreign final absorption.
notes.ghg_trade: Upstream production GHG embodied in signed gross intermediate and final-use crossings. Repeated border crossings can count the same emissions again. Direct final-user emissions and unrepresented production accounts are not allocated to traded output. Source-characterised AR5 GWP100 CO2eq (CO2, CH4, N2O and F-gases). The parser-specific isolated Irish paper-incineration loop correction retains original production accounts; its unallocable emissions stay by production origin, without consumer allocation.

sector_scope.boundary: Supplying industry/product of traded output or final demand
sector_scope.qualification: The selected sector identifies the supplying industry/product at the border or in final demand; upstream value added and emissions can arise in every industry. Mixed native groups are indivisible. Unassigned native groups remain separate; named sections show the identified mapped portion when an unassigned group exists.

provenance.input_inventory_scope: Explicit files, or every non-hidden file in the selected same-year/release directory bundle; directory inventories can include unused companions.
